verdict.rationale: The evidence describes SOSPortal only as a web UI for filing, ordering copies, searching, drafts and status tracking, with MFA and ACH/credit-card payment. No API is documented, so there is nothing to show API parity with the UI. An online government filing service could plausibly offer an API, so the axis applies, and the absence of any documented API makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
